purpose: Optional hidden-state and fail-safe probe atlas used during full-stack orchestration when the executable dynamical process is invoked to monitor latent instability, entropy divergence, and recovery posture.

integration_policy.pipeline_role: optional runtime support layer for Dynamical Prism execution

default_balanced.description: Balanced project defaults for general cognitive-tools orchestration.

safety_critical.description: Stricter fail-safe posture for projects where unstable coupling or hidden-state drift is expensive.

exploration_heavy.description: Looser thresholds for speculative or research-heavy projects where wider search is acceptable.

escape_sensitive.description: Bias toward early escape detection and fallback-basin discipline.

entropy_gap.comment: Use when coordination entropy rises above the expected basin for stable reasoning.

tissues.name: state_guard
tissues.role: monitor hidden instability, regime drift, and irreversible commitment risk

entropy_gap.comment: Escalate fail-safe checks when hidden instability remains above a moderate entropy band.

tissues.name: escape_router
tissues.role: track whether paradox pressure requires bounded escape or fallback regime selection

entropy_gap.comment: Use a lower entropy target because escape routing should narrow search rather than widen it.

global_regulators.rollback_posture: prefer lower-commitment stable basin before further coupling or transform escalation

experimental_limitations.methodological_gap: functional probing substitutes for direct observation
experimental_limitations.entropy_gap_comment: use when observed entropy diverges from predicted coordination

cognitive_tools_handoff.handoff_note: Use only as an optional adjunct to executable dynamical probing. Do not treat the organ atlas as a replacement for the canonical dynamical profile. Project profiles or explicit parameter overrides may tune fail-safe thresholds without changing the canonical packet vocabulary.
